claims.content: To aid Customer Service Representatives in troubleshooting customer service issues by providing access to customer account, order, and bid history information.

goal.raw_text: To aid Customer Service Representatives in troubleshooting customer service issues by providing access to customer account, order, and bid history information.

claims.content: Customer Service Representative
The Customer Service Representative must have access to the Auction Administration interface, specifically the Customer History page.
The system must be operational and connected to the database containing customer account, order, and bid history records.
The Customer Service Representative must possess valid user credentials with permissions to view customer information and account notes.
A Customer Service Representative needs to troubleshoot a customer service issue regarding an auction.

trigger.raw_text: A Customer Service Representative needs to troubleshoot a customer service issue regarding an auction.

claims.content: The Customer Service Representative accesses the Customer History page within the Auction Administration interface.
The representative searches for the customer's account using their email address, phone number, or name.
Upon finding the account, the representative reviews the customer's general information, account notes, and payment method details.
The representative examines the Order History section to view order dates, auction sequences, item numbers, amounts, and status.
The representative examines the Bid History section to view closing dates, auction sequences, item numbers, last bids, smart bids, and winning bids.
If the Customer Service Representative determines the account needs to be suspended or deactivated, they must obtain a supervisor's authorization code via a pop-up DIV layer to proceed.

If the customer's account is in 'Review Status' due to unpaid auction winnings (orders expired after 7 days), the representative may unlock the account if the customer has not exceeded the limit of three unpaid orders (unless the rate is below 10%).

If the customer is subject to the escalation policy (more than three unpaid orders in twelve months and >10% cancellation rate), the representative cannot simply unlock the account; the customer must update their account with a credit card to be removed from Review Status.

If the Customer Service Representative attempts to deactivate or suspend a customer account, the system requires a supervisor's authorization code entered via a pop-up DIV layer to proceed; without this code, the action cannot be completed.

If a customer's account is in 'Review Status' due to unpaid auction winnings (orders expired after 7 days), the Customer Service Representative may unlock the account only if the customer has not exceeded the limit of three unpaid orders (unless the rate is below 10%).

If the customer is subject to the escalation policy (more than three unpaid orders in twelve months and >10% cancellation rate), the Customer Service Representative cannot simply unlock the account; the exception path requires the customer to update their account with a credit card to be removed from Review Status.
The Customer Service Representative has successfully accessed and viewed the customer's general account information, including name, contact details, and IP address.
The Customer Service Representative has reviewed the customer's Order History, including order dates, auction sequences, item numbers, amounts, and status (with cancelled orders highlighted in red).
The Customer Service Representative has reviewed the customer's Bid History, including closing dates, auction sequences, item numbers, last bids, smart bids, and winning bids.
The Customer Service Representative has accessed the Account Notes section, which is a free-form text field for CSR use.
The current default Method of Payment (MOP) information is displayed, showing card type, expiration date, and last four digits if applicable.
If account suspension or deactivation was performed, it required a supervisor's authorization code entered via a pop-up DIV layer.
